job.title: Licensed Practical Nurse | Neuroscience
job.description:
Find your purpose helping patients as a Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) in the Neuroscience Spine Unit! St. Cloud Hospital emphasizes professional development, diversity, and high-quality patient care. The position offers a dynamic and supportive environment. This unit, certified as a Comprehensive Stroke Center, focuses on providing high-quality care for neurological and spine patients. As a step-down ICU and Neuro unit, no two days are alike!

Schedule:

  • Part-time | 32-56 hours every two weeks | Nights | 8-hr shifts | 11pm-7:30am |every otherweekend and rotating holidays  

 

Pay and Benefits:

  • Starting pay begins at $25.20 per hour and increases with experience
    • Pay range: $25.20 - $38.57 per hour
  • Earn extra pay for working evening/night/weekend shifts 
  • $2,500 hiring bonus and $5,000 in relocation assistance for eligible candidates!
  • Benefits: medical, dental, PTO, retirement, employee discounts and more!

 

Qualifications:

  • Graduate of an accredited LPN program
  • Current Minnesota LPN License
  • Basic Life Support (BLS) Certification

 

The Neuroscience Spine Unit is a 45-bed unit consisting of 8 Neuro Progressive Care Unit beds and 37 general neuroscience patient rooms. We treat patients who have had Neurosurgical, Neuro-interventional, and Neuro-medical diseases and disorders. In addition, we serve stroke, seizure, multiple trauma, and traumatic brain injury patients. 

To be eligible for the Hiring Bonus you must be an external candidate who is hired into an eligible full-time or part-time benefited position. Previous CentraCare/Carris employees qualify if they have not worked for CentraCare for at least 9 months at the date of hire.

To be eligible for Relocation Assistance, you must accept a position that offers benefits and may not have worked for CentraCare in the last nine months. Must currently reside more than 50 miles away from St. Cloud Hospital and relocate to within 30 miles of it.

CentraCare hiring incentives to include but not limited to, hiring and relocation bonuses may be discontinued at any time. 


CentraCare has made a commitment to diversity in its workforce. All individuals including, but not limited to, individuals with disabilities, are encouraged to apply. CentraCare is an EEO/AA employer.
